name: pocket-tts
description: Pocket TTS (8-bit): speaks English in a voice copied from a few seconds of reference audio, on a CPU. It has no built-in voices; create one with `oaudio voice create`.

license.notes: Kyutai publishes the weights under CC-BY-4.0, which allows commercial use with credit, and the archive carries that license file. But the README inside the same archive, written by the ONNX exporter, says "It is for non-commercial." The two disagree, so this is marked non-commercial until the authors settle it. The original repository asks users to accept its terms before download. Clone a voice only with the speaker's consent.
